tree: Buckeye Comfort Plumbing in Columbus, OH has two crews and one dispatcher, Ryan Bennett, who is often on a job site himself.

tree.style: margin: 24px 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; display: grid; gap: 14px; font-size: 16.5px; line-height: 1.55; color: #0b1620;

tree: — Grace Mitchell calls about a leaking water heater. Nobody can pick up.
— The missed call is logged; her web-form text opt-in from Sep 28 is found.
— A follow-up draft lands on Ryan’s phone with a 15-minute callback window.
— Ryan approves the text. At 2:31 PM he calls back and books a 4:00 PM visit; the outcome is saved to lead LD-1042.
